summary: Legacy/archived package guidance. Its extension-helper namespaces now ship from ReactiveUI.Primitives and ReactiveUI.Primitives.Reactive; async-native contracts use ReactiveUI.Primitives.Async.
recommendedPatterns: Use ReactiveUI.Primitives.Async IObservableAsync-based flows when async streams are a better fit than ad hoc Task glue.
Use the extension helpers now included in ReactiveUI.Primitives when they match the domain clearly.
Adopt async observable composition deliberately for IO-heavy or streaming workflows so generated code stays idiomatic and reusable.
avoidPatterns: Do not add the archived ReactiveUI.Extensions package to new projects.
Do not add removed ReactiveUI.Primitives.Extensions package references; replace the reference with the matching base package.
Do not mix Task-based and async-observable-based orchestration randomly without a consistent boundary.
setupSteps: Replace ReactiveUI.Extensions with ReactiveUI.Primitives; existing extension namespaces remain available.
Add ReactiveUI.Primitives.Async when generating IObservableAsync-based code.
Document why async observables are used so the generated codebase remains maintainable.
commonPitfalls: Adding unnecessary dependencies for simple Rx pipelines.
Hiding domain intent behind overly clever operator chains.
Ignoring IObservableAsync patterns even when async streaming semantics would simplify the code.
